title: the_seed_that_watched
beats: I found a parkour seed on a dead channel with zero views, uploaded eleven years ago -- and the last comment just said 'don't finish it.'
I loaded it up anyway, 34M, three thousand subs, needed content.
The course was perfect: obsidian towers, precise jumps, no lag, like someone had built it for exactly my skill level.
That's when I noticed -- every block matched a screenshot from MY old abandoned world from 2013.
I kept climbing anyway, filming, laughing it off for the video.
At block 200, there was a sign with my real name on it -- not my username, my actual name.
I panicked, alt-F4'd, deleted the world file.
Reinstalled Minecraft an hour later to double check I wasn't losing it.
The seed was already in my worlds list, freshly 'last played' -- and I hadn't touched it. Tell me I'm not crazy.
